name: Whisk
notes: Standard name (International Style waltz); the owner's class doesn't name it. Owner's description, corrected after watching a video: forward on the left, side on the right landing level with it, then the lead's left foot crosses behind his right, the shoulders open and the couple ends in promenade, ready for a promenade figure. Both partners open an eighth into the V. Separate lead and follow rows on 3 because they turn opposite ways. Reviewed by the owner (2026-11-19).
